name: Riya's Bracelet
competency: Interactive storytelling, tactile 1-to-10 counting, number bonds to 10, and waste-prevention conservation logic
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 5 (Numbers to 10)
overview: Riya has a 10-bead bracelet. Children count the 10 beads together, trigger the exciting 'crazy thing' snap where beads scatter, help Riya who recovered only 3 beads, and visit the bead shop where the shopkeeper advises not to buy more than needed to avoid waste across four levels (3, 5, 2, 8).
learningOutcomes: Count items from 1 to 10 with 1-to-1 correspondence and audio reinforcement
Understand quantity conservation and waste prevention (not buying more than 10)
